description: Simulated grouped data: 21 ordinary schools and 3 large schools with high zs and different coefficients. The column school holds the cluster id.
generator_code:
{
    n_low <- 21L
    n_high <- 3L
    g <- n_low + n_high
    size <- c(sample(15:35, n_low, replace = TRUE), sample(60:90, n_high, replace = TRUE))
    school <- rep(seq_len(g), size)
    n <- length(school)
    zs <- c(runif(n_low, 0, 6), runif(n_high, 8, 10))
    high <- zs[school] > 7
    u <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.7)[school]
    d <- data.frame(school = school, x1 = rnorm(n), x2 = rnorm(n), x3 = rnorm(n), zs = zs[school])
    d$y <- u + ifelse(high, 6, 0) + (1 + ifelse(high, -6, 0)) * d$x1 + 0.5 * d$x2 - 0.5 * d$x3 + rnorm(n)
    d[sample(n), ]
}
